claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Phenazopyridine is a local anesthetic/analgesic with no coherent antiproliferative mechanism at 2.5 uM; any killing would be weak, non-selective, and likely reflect a physicochemical/off-target effect rather than a targeted anticancer mechanism.
